turns.assistant_response: Transfers can take anywhere from a few minutes to a few hours depending on the type and bank/rail involved. Since it’s only been a couple of hours, it may still be processing—what transfer method did you use (bank transfer/SWIFT, or another in-app transfer), and do you see it marked as pending or completed in your app?
